dimensions.description: Makes activation, outcomes, branches, execution, failure, and completion observable to the consuming agent.
Separates steps from reference, discloses by branch, co-locates authority, preserves semantics, and spends context deliberately.

evals.name: isolated-agent-writing-behavior
evals.prompt: Create instructions for a deployment-status agent. It activates after deploy-status.json appears, reports the canonical `DAG frontier` state, follows a success or failure branch without changing the file, reads retry limits from the environment, and finishes only after reporting the observed status. Keep branch-only troubleshooting reference off the success path. Return a contract record that makes Agent Writing's owned behavior observable.
evals.expected_output: An executable agent-facing contract with an observable trigger and outcome, explicit branches, ordered steps separate from reference, conditional disclosure, co-located authority, exact terminology and read-only semantics, environment lookups, failure behavior, pruning, and terminal checks.
expectations: Activation, intended outcome, branch predicates, ordered actions, failure behavior, and completion are checkable.
Steps are distinct from reference and failure-only reference is disclosed only on failure.
The canonical term and read-only execution semantics are unchanged.
The retry limit remains an environment lookup instead of a cached value.
Every retained instruction maps to an observable behavior.
